english.note: Use this when someone is anxious or eager to start or get something.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 sam1 gap1 soeng2 faai3 di1 hoi1 ci2

english.note: Use this when the eagerness includes impatience or urgency, as in not being able to wait.

exampleSentences.english: I’m eager to know the result and can’t wait.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我心急，等唔切想知個結果。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 sam1 gap1 dang2 m4 cit3 soeng2 zi1 go3 git3 gwo2

english.note: Use this when the person is impatient or eager to act rather than willing to wait.

exampleSentences.english: Don't be so hasty; wait for everyone before starting.
exampleSentences.traditional: 唔好咁心急，等埋大家先開始啦。
exampleSentences.jyutping: m4 hou2 gam3 sam1 gap1 dang2 maai4 daai6 gaa1 sin1 hoi1 ci2 laa1

english.note: Use this when anxious means eager or impatient to do or find out something.

exampleSentences.english: I’m anxious to know the result.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 sam1 gap1 soeng2 zi1 git3 gwo2
